rows.label: Married couples and single parents

rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Bern (Stand: Februar 2026), Einkommenssteuer: Steuerberechnung, Art. 42 StG

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Bern; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Bern; other communes in Bern set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)
